modelClaim.name: Kling 4.0
modelClaim.sourceTextOriginal:
A street musician’s violin breaks. The pieces rise and keep playing.

Text-to-video. Kling 4 had to hold the rain, the light, and the transformation in one continuous shot. The idea is simple; the continuity is the hard part.
Ambient sounds are missing though (prompt in comment) https://t.co/DZAccIpyux

originalPrompt: A street musician sits alone on wet pavement at night under a single streetlight. He plays a violin. The violin slowly cracks and falls silent. As the pieces break, they lift into the air and reassemble into floating, glowing shards that continue the melody. Slow continuous camera move, rain and neon reflections stay consistent. Emotional, restrained, 20 seconds.
